items.title: Custody’s next chapter: State Street’s Ambrosius on AI, tokenisation and the race for scale
items.summary: Global Custodian’s Chris Lemmon sits down with Jörg Ambrosius, president of State Street Investment Services, to discuss how technology is reshaping custody and administration – and the risks that come with it.

items.title: DTCC launches tokenisation service for DTC-custodied securities
items.summary: The service has signed up 20 DTC participants, including Citi, JP Morgan and State Street, and will initially connect to the Canton Network and DTCC’s private Besu network.

items.title: BNY expands digital asset custody for Ripple
items.summary: Expanded relationship adds XRP and RLUSD to BNY’s custody platform, as the firms explore tokenised trade finance and other institutional uses for blockchain.

items.title: Standard Chartered to integrate Zodia Custody into existing digital asset custody activities
items.summary: The deal will bring Zodia Custody’s regulated digital asset custody operations into Standard Chartered’s securities services business, while its software and professional services arm will be spun out into a separate entity.

items.title: Senior HSBC digital assets executive to exit role
items.summary: Executive to leave role after more than two years at HSBC, having previously spent nearly a decade at State Street working across digital asset strategy and product development.

items.title: BNY expands digital asset custody platform in Europe
items.summary: The move follows the addition of BNY’s European banking entity to the EU’s MiCA register in July.

items.title: Standard Chartered expands digital asset custody into Singapore
items.summary: The bank plans to offer custody for selected crypto assets, stablecoins and tokenised real-world assets, adding Singapore to its growing network of digital asset custody markets.

items.title: Euroclear loses global digital assets lead to Apex Group
items.summary: Executive departs after helping build Euroclear's digital assets practice and launch its first digital market infrastructure.

items.title: Euroclear appoints former HSBC exec as APAC head of collateral management and digital assets
items.summary: Executive joins Euroclear from HSBC, having also held roles at JP Morgan, BNY, Barclays and Deutsche Bank.

items.title: LMAX appoints Standard Chartered as digital asset custodian
items.summary: LMAX Group becomes the first client to onboard onto the bank’s Luxembourg digital asset custody platform following its Mica authorisation in June.

items.title: Deutsche Bank to launch digital asset custody service in Europe
items.summary: Offering will initially support Bitcoin, Ether and selected stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe.

items.title: BNP Paribas reshuffles digital assets team with senior appointments
items.summary: Securities services reorganises digital assets department with appointments to head of digital assets and market & client engagement lead roles.

items.title: ESMA launches review of digital asset custody resilience
items.summary: The EU regulator will examine how crypto-asset service providers manage operational risks around custody as digital asset infrastructure develops.

items.title: Northern Trust taps Lukka for digital asset data and reporting
items.summary: Agreement will give Northern Trust access to Lukka’s data infrastructure across blockchain networks, exchanges and other digital asset sources.

items.title: BNY partners with Galaxy to expand institutional digital asset offering
items.summary: Collaboration will combine digital asset custody and staking within a single servicing model, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: Digital Asset names former JP Morgan veteran as head of clearance and collateral management
items.summary: Executive joins the digital asset infrastructure provider from Pirum, following leadership roles at JP Morgan and Morgan Stanley, to drive tokenised collateral and post-trade initiatives.

items.title: BBH names head of investor services digital asset strategy
items.summary: Executive joins from Fidelity Investments, where he led digital asset infrastructure initiatives for institutional clients.

items.title: Euroclear names new head of digital assets
items.summary: Former Zodia Markets CEO joins to lead its digital assets strategy, bringing more than 17 years of capital markets technology experience from the likes of HSBC and Merrill Lynch.

items.title: Fireside Friday with… Transcend’s Bimal Kadikar
items.summary: Bimal Kadikar, founder & CEO of Transcend, discusses the firm’s recent Series B investment with 7RIDGE, its expansion into collateral, liquidity and tokenised markets, and how it is building infrastructure to bridge traditional and digital financial ecosystems through optimisation, interoperability and AI-driven…

items.title: Digital Asset raises $355 million to expand Canton network as institutional onchain infrastructure
items.summary: HSBC, BNP Paribas, Citadel Securities, CME Ventures and Broadridge among investors backing latest round as focus shifts to regulated blockchain market infrastructure.

items.title: BNY joins Finstreet and ADI Foundation on UAE digital asset custody initiative
items.summary: ADGM-anchored collaboration will initially focus on Bitcoin and Ethereum custody, with plans to expand into stablecoins and tokenised real-world assets.

items.title: Chainlink and Apex Group among consortium to complete Bermuda digital asset compliance initiative
items.summary: The two firms collaborate with Bluprynt and Hacken on the project, bringing together multiple components to address ‘key supervisory challenges’.

items.title: Northern Trust flags digital asset momentum as Q1 servicing fees hit $740.5m
items.summary: Assets under custody/administration hold at $18.6 trillion as market tailwinds and client activity support growth.

items.title: Zodia Custody to support Australian dollar stablecoin AUDM
items.summary: The digital assets custodian, backed by Standard Chartered and Northern Trust, adds support for Macropod’s Australian dollar-backed stablecoin, giving institutional clients secure access to the token for payments and settlement use cases.
